issue.title: Crontabs as code through chezmoi, with first-class agent access
issue.description: One committed cron: block in the chezmoi repo is the single source of truth for every machine's user crontab; chezmoi update -a converges each machine's own marked block without touching other lines, and agents can read and write any machine's crontab from any machine through cronctl, a /crontab skill, and a global memory note.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: chezmoi repo `just test-nvim` / `just test-hammerspoon` fail on athena before running any spec — `~/.luarocks/bin/nlua` busted 2.3.0 cannot load module busted.runner (package.path lacks the luarocks tree); reproduces identically on the clean base tree (f1da6b64), so `just test` is red locally while CI is unaffected.

Handoff for sync/remote: partials are cron-validate (cron), cron-machine (hostname, cron), cron-block (machine, cron), cron-retire (machine, cron), plus cron-host (output=block|retire, hostname, cron) which the run_onchange hook can call twice for this host. Every partial validates first, even for unknown hosts. Gotcha: chezmoi v2.74.0 drops the middle segment of fail messages shaped "a: <word>: c" (prints "a: c"), so keep fail text to one "path: message" prefix. Renders are byte-identical on v2.13.1 and v2.74.0.

render phase done in chezmoi repo: home/.chezmoidata.yaml cron: schema (version 1; athena/apollo/mac enrolled; MAILTO env; jobs []; retire {}), .chezmoitemplates cron-validate/cron-machine/cron-block/cron-retire/cron-host, dot_config/cron/managed.crontab.tmpl + retire.crontab.tmpl (one-liners), tests/bash/cron_render_test.sh (41 tests: real data for every machine+hostname, golden fixture, quoting round-trip through /bin/sh incl. ' % $(date +%F) pipe $HOME, disabled/[all]/sorted env, unknown host renders 0 bytes, zero-jobs markers-only, one fail test per validation rule). Verified: 41/41 pass on chezmoi v2.13.1 (athena nix) and v2.74.0 (latest release, checksum-verified); renders byte-identical across both; chezmoi apply into a temp dest creates only managed.crontab on enrolled hosts and nothing on unknown hosts on both versions; full-source chezmoi cat/diff on athena OK. just lint green; just test-bash 343/343, test-python 26/26; test-nvim/test-hammerspoon fail identically on clean base (busted.runner missing; follow-up noted).

NOTE for remote/sync phases: cronrun state lives in ~/.local/state/cron/ — <job>.log (+ .log.1, rotated past 1 MiB), <job>.status (job host pid start end exit; end/exit empty while running), <job>.lock (flock) and <job>.lock.d/pid (mkdir fallback, used on the Mac, which has no flock). Lock impl override: CRONRUN_LOCK_IMPL=flock|mkdir. `cronrun --dry-run <job> <cmd>` writes nothing and exits 1 when the first word does not resolve; usage errors exit 2. host= is `hostname -s` (Mac reports Kellys-MacBook-Pro, not the alias mac).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: chezmoi `just test` fails in non-interactive shells on athena because test-nvim cannot find busted.runner — busted is only on LUA_PATH after `eval "$(luarocks path --bin)"`; with that loaded every test recipe passes. The test-nvim recipe (or CI-parity docs) could load luarocks paths itself. Not caused by this phase; reproduces with no changes.

Added chezmoi home/bin/executable_cronrun (cronrun [--dry-run] <job> <command>; bash 3.2-compatible, no jq/python) and tests/bash/cronrun_test.sh (18 tests): silent success writes log+status; failure prints summary + last 40 lines of this run and propagates the exit code; overlap skipped under flock and the mkdir fallback (stale and recycled pids broken); log rotates past the size cap; --dry-run never executes or writes state; runtime env set only when unset and only on Linux; profile sourcing and its failure logged; stdin is /dev/null; the lock fd is not inherited by children. Verified: 18/18 on athena (bash 5); 17 passed and 1 skipped (flock-only test) on the Mac under /bin/bash 3.2.57; real-HOME cron-like (env -i) dry-runs resolve pass_git_sync, bob, and the nvm-prefixed bob nightly command on athena (derived XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/DBUS/DISPLAY match the legacy hard-coded lines), and maybe_bob_highlights_sync and bob on the Mac, writing no state. shellcheck clean; just lint passes; test-nvim, test-hammerspoon, test-bash (319/319), and test-python all pass with luarocks paths loaded (see PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP).

payload.entry: Handoff for remote/agent-docs/migrate: home/bin/executable_cronctl is all functions with `main "$@"` last; every child reads </dev/null or a file. crontab ALWAYS gets its file on stdin (`crontab - <file`, also `crontab -n -`): Debian cron 3.0pl1 silently truncates crontab file arguments to 99 bytes (verified on athena: a long agent TMPDIR path made `crontab -n` open a truncated path), so a file argument could name a different file -- keep this in remote code. Reusable internals: cronctl_template <tmpl> <out> (returns 2 on a template fail = validation, 1 on chezmoi error), cronctl_resolve_local (sets cronctl_hostname/cronctl_machine; CRONCTL_HOSTNAME test hook), cronctl_find_chezmoi (CRONCTL_CHEZMOI, CHEZMOI_EXECUTABLE, PATH, then ~/.nix-profile/bin /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin ~/bin ~/go/bin ~/.local/bin), cronctl_read_crontab, cronctl_read_block, cronctl_build_candidate, cronctl_probe_native_check (Debian -n / cronie -T found by parsing `crontab -h`). Added a dry-run-only `sync --retire FILE` next to `--block FILE`, so `diff --source` can preview a checkout block AND its retire lines on a target. sync state: installed.block, backups/crontab.<UTC stamp> (20 kept), sync.lock (flock fd 8) or sync.lock.d/pid (CRONCTL_LOCK_IMPL, CRONCTL_LOCK_TIMEOUT default 60s); sync runs under umask 077. Offline tests are tests/bash/cronctl_offline_test.sh, so tests/bash/cronctl_test.sh stays free for remote. Mac facts (2026-11-07): its chezmoi source is at ec5ff17d with no cron partials yet, so `cronctl sync` there cannot resolve until apply pulls; Homebrew flock exists at /opt/homebrew/bin but is off the non-interactive PATH.

sync phase done in the chezmoi repo: home/bin/executable_cronctl (list [--json] [--source], render <m> [--source], check [--source], sync [--dry-run [--block F] [--retire F]], help; --help on every command; exit 0/1/2) and .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_sync_crontab.sh.tmpl (enrolled host: inert heredoc with its block + retire lines, cronctl sha256, then exec "$HOME/bin/cronctl" sync; unknown host: renders empty). sync follows plan steps 1-9: resolve via cron-machine (unknown host or missing managed.crontab warns, exits 0), lock (flock or mkdir with stale-pid break), read (no crontab = empty; any other -l failure exits 1), markers (0 pairs insert on top, 1 pair replace in place, else refuse), retire exact matches outside the block only, hand-edit warning vs installed.block, dry-run diff, backup (keep 20) + native syntax check (probed), re-read/rebuild once, install, read back, restore backup on mismatch, record installed.block + one-line summary. Tests: tests/bash/cron_sync_test.sh (34: every plan case incl. watchdog-line preservation, byte-identical no-op with no installer call, verify-failure restore, mkdir and flock lock paths, hook empty/enrolled/changes, mid-sync change rebuild, plus an end-to-end chezmoi apply -> hook -> sync test) and tests/bash/cronctl_offline_test.sh (16: list text/JSON, render, check incl. native check, help/usage, bash -s streaming with no stdin reads). Verified: all 109 cron tests pass on chezmoi v2.13.1 and v2.74.0 (athena, bash 5) and on the Mac under /bin/bash 3.2.57 with chezmoi v2.52.1; shellcheck + shfmt clean; just lint green; just test green (test-nvim/test-hammerspoon need `eval "$(luarocks path --bin)"` in non-interactive shells, as bob-cli-ib.2 noted). Rollout preview on athena (read-only): `render athena --source <checkout>` + `sync --dry-run --block`, and the default managed.crontab dry run, both only add the 3-line block (markers + MAILTO) above the existing lines and remove nothing; `check` on the real data is ok on all 3 machines with Debian `crontab -n`. A post-commit `chezmoi update -a --force` monitor is staged to perform and verify the first real install on athena.

Handoff for agent-docs/migrate: cronctl now has status [--all|<m>...] [--json] [--all-schedulers], diff <m> [--source DIR], apply (--all|<m>...) [--rev REV], logs <job> [--machine M] [-n N], run <job> [--machine M], and edit (help on each; exit 0/1/2/3 per the contract). Remote targets get `ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 <alias> bash -s -- __state|__apply|__logs|__run ...` with the caller script on stdin (run passes the job command and cron.env as quoted shell assignments ahead of the script, never on the ssh command line); the local machine runs the same routine in a subshell, no SSH. Routines answer key=value lines, ">section" + "|"-prefixed lines, and end=1; the caller classifies. status states: pending = unreachable, source behind/diverged from origin, or ~/.config/cron not matching the target source (not applied); unmanaged = applied but no block; drifted = cronctl sync would change the table; identity_mismatch; failed; in_sync. "cron.retire can be deleted" prints only when every machine with retire lines was read in that run and none remain (otherwise "cron.retire is still needed: <why>"), so run it with --all. run takes the command from the caller local source data and refuses disabled jobs or machines the job does not target. The script now ends in `{ main "$@"; exit; }` because chezmoi rewrites ~/bin/cronctl in place when its temp dir is on another device. Live fleet 2026-11-07 (read-only): apollo in_sync; athena pending only because ~/.local/share/chezmoi is behind origin (block already live; diff athena = no changes); mac pending (source current, never applied: no managed.crontab, 3 legacy */15 lines outside). All origins are git@github.com and apollo/mac can ls-remote over non-interactive SSH, so apply pull works there.

Verified: chezmoi repo home/bin/executable_cronctl gains status/diff/apply/logs/run/edit with SSH-streamed internal routines (script on stdin, children </dev/null, local machine via subshell, exit 255 = pending) and new tests/bash/cronctl_test.sh (23 tests: apply with no prior ~/bin/cronctl, unreachable -> pending + exit 3, unpushed --rev refused, identity_mismatch, local target uses no SSH, status states incl. retire lines still present and cron.retire can be deleted, --json via python3 -m json.tool, diff output, logs tail across rotation, run via cronrun with cron env, edit, stdin-leak guard plus a negative proof). All 132 cron tests pass on chezmoi v2.13.1 and v2.74.0 (athena), and the 73 cronctl/sync tests pass on the Mac (/bin/bash 3.2.57, chezmoi v2.52.1, mkdir lock). shellcheck + shfmt -i 2 clean; just lint green; just test green except 2 poseidon_chezmoi_isolation_test failures that reproduce identically on the clean base (recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP). Real fleet read-only: cronctl status --all = apollo in_sync, athena pending (source behind origin; block live), mac pending (never applied); cronctl diff athena = block: no changes.

Handoff for migrate: the /crontab skill source is home/sase/skills/crontab.md (read it from the chezmoi checkout until deployed); its write flow stages `sase monitor start --reason ... --timeout 15m --start-status 'APPLYING CRONTAB' --stop-status 'APPLIED CRONTAB' --next '<checkout>/home/bin/executable_cronctl status <machines> ...' -- <checkout>/home/bin/executable_cronctl apply <machines>` (flags checked against sase monitor start --help). Remote cronrun dry run: `ssh -o BatchMode=yes <m> "bash -s -- --dry-run <job> '<command>'" < <checkout>/home/bin/executable_cronrun` (verified locally via bash -s). sase skill init is hard-wired to ~/.local/share/chezmoi/home and only deploys committed, landed sources, so the 7 per-provider copies and the 7 .sase-skills-manifest.json entries were produced with the generator's exact transform; a temp-HOME run of the installed sase over a copy of this tree reported all 168 targets current, `skill init --check`/`--diff` clean, and prepare_skill_manifest would write nothing (macro_set_sha256 recomputed by sase itself; the baseline hash reproduced first). Gotcha: a plain YAML description must not contain 'cron: ' (colon-space), or the frontmatter fails to parse and the skill silently stops registering.

Done in the chezmoi linked repo: added the global /crontab skill (home/sase/skills/crontab.md) teaching the read flow (status/list/render/diff/logs), the write flow (sase repo open → edit cron: data → check/diff --source → cronrun --dry-run → staged post-commit cronctl apply monitor → /sase_final), and the rules; generated its 7 per-provider SKILL.md copies plus manifest entries, verified byte-exact by the installed sase in a temp HOME (168/168 targets current, manifest no-op). Created reference memory home/sase/memory/crontab.md (decision crontab_memory_note) and added a one-line [[crontab.md]] link to tailnet.md (decision tailnet_memory_link); both links resolve via sase memory show; home memory README re-rendered with sase's own renderer. Added a ## Crontabs section to README.md. Repointed vcron to 'cronctl edit' and deleted vab/vdb/vwb/vmb (bash -n and zsh -n clean). Verified: just lint passes; just test-bash 432/434 (2 known poseidon failures that reproduce on the clean base, see bob-cli-ib.4 note); just test-python 26/26; test-nvim/test-hammerspoon cannot start locally (busted.runner missing; follow-up noted). Live read-only check with the checkout's cronctl: check ok for 3 machines, status --all = athena in_sync, apollo pending (source behind origin), mac pending (asleep), exit 3.
